question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"there."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"There (**वहाँ, उस स्‍थान में या पर)**"** is used to refer to a place or location.
 
• It can also be used as an exclamation to draw attention to something.
 
 
• **Example:** ***There__** are many students in my class.*
 
 
 
• In this context, **"there"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it refers to a location where the correct answer can be found.
 
• Grammatically, **"there"** is classified as an adverb of place.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.
 
• Correct paragraph:

Literacy is a very important quality of a population. __Only__ an informed and educated citizen can make __intelligent__ choices and undertake research and development __projects__. Low levels of literacy are a __serious__ obstacle for economic improvement. In India, __**there**__ has been a steady improvement in the literacy levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1,** "here (जहाँ आप हैं वहाँ या उस ओर, या जिस ओर आप इशारा कर रहे हैं; यहाँ)"**, refers to the speaker's location and would not make sense in this context.
 
• Option 2,** "their (उनका)"**, is a possessive pronoun used to indicate ownership and is not relevant to the sentence.
 
• Option 4, **"it (पूर्व-वर्णित पशु या कोई वस्‍तु)"**, is a pronoun used to refer to a previously mentioned noun and does not fit in this context.

97:Td5e,

The correct answer is **"referred."**
